legal_units.title: Estimation of value of assets by Valuation Officer.
legal_units.text: The Assessing Officer may, for the purposes of assessment or reassessment, make a reference to a Valuation Officer to estimate the value, including the fair market value, of any asset, property or investment and submit a copy of report to him.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 269 Estimation of value of assets by Valuation Officer. Section 269(1): The Assessing Officer may, for the purposes of assessment or reassessment, make a reference to a Valuation Officer to estimate the value, including the fair market value, of any asset, property or investment and submit a copy of report to him.

legal_units.title: Estimation of value of assets by Valuation Officer.
legal_units.text: The Assessing Officer may make a reference to the Valuation Officer under sub-section (1) whether or not he is satisfied about the correctness or completeness of the accounts of the assessee.

legal_units.text: The Valuation Officer shall, estimate the value of the asset, property or investment after taking into account such evidence as the assessee may produce and any other evidence in his possession gathered, after giving an opportunity of being heard to the assessee.

legal_units.title: Estimation of value of assets by Valuation Officer.
legal_units.text: The Valuation Officer may estimate the value of the asset, property or investment to the best of his judgment, if the assessee does not co-operate or comply with his directions.
